$comment: sigrix-learning-path/1's case table: path.json documents a reader takes, and documents it refuses, each
made by one RFC 6902 change to one it takes, so that each is refused for that change and nothing else. A
refused case's reason is where its rule is, as a JSON Pointer to the member the rule is about (for a
member a document must have, the one it lacks; for an item of a list, the item), and the schema keyword
that refuses it. Every implementation runs the table: a writer holds what it writes to the schema beside
it, and a reader with a checker of its own holds that checker to the table too, so that the two cannot
disagree about what the format allows. A change's value is repeated as many times as the case's "times"
says, for a text too long to write out. Every lesson in it is made up.
